integrity: Analytic proof supplies all-integer dimensional and min-max steps; the standalone finite-dimensional program is a reproducibility check, not an infinite proof. First public date is the initial 2025-12-26 arXiv appearance, not its later journal date.
scientific_limitations: Assumes exact excited-level degeneracy, precise permutation-symmetric input support and unrestricted global cyclic unitaries. Provides a static work bound, not a charging kinetics or feasible-control cost theorem. Contemporary two-cell qutrit paper arXiv:2610.05592 was accessible only at abstract level; unlocated broader rank consequences remain a publication-priority risk.
title: Sharp excitation-population work witnesses and a three-qutrit universal discharge threshold
